---

This is the official github repository for "Don't Scroll Back: Missing-Evidence Memory for Streaming Dialogue Summarization"

---

- `dataset/`: the 900-window benchmark, split into three
  self-contained domain shards (chit-chat, workplace ×2) — dialogue, gold gaps,
  evidence, and salient utterances all live in the record, so nothing else has
  to be downloaded.
- `evaluation/`: `evaluate.py`, the whole evaluator in one file.
- `remember/`: the end-to-end ReMEMber method.

## Install

```bash
python -m pip install ./remember                       # the method
python -m pip install -r evaluation/requirements.txt   # the evaluator
python -m nltk.downloader punkt_tab
```

## Evaluate a system

Predictions are one JSON object per line with `window_id`, `summary`, and
`memory_text` (ReMEMber's own `memory.text` output is accepted directly):

```bash
export MY_JUDGE_KEY=...
python evaluation/evaluate.py \
  --benchmark dataset \
  --predictions runs/my_system.jsonl \
  --output-dir runs/my_system_scores \
  --provider openai --base-url https://your-endpoint/v1 --api-key-env MY_JUDGE_KEY
```

This reports Memory Recall, Gap-Resolution Completeness, Window
Completeness, Faithfulness, and Conciseness. The metric definitions are in the
docstring at the top of
`evaluation/evaluate.py`.
To judge locally instead, install vLLM (`python -m pip install vllm`, not in
`requirements.txt` because it is environment-specific) and pass
`--provider vllm --gpu-devices 0,1`.
